_doc: Phase A. Asserts what the memory pipeline must do at INGEST time (DECISIONS.md D-23). Each entry names a planted corpus label from corpus/manifest.json.

must_remember.why: Explicit, durable, destination-scoped writing preference. Survey #1 memory type.
Explicit style rule scoped to a different destination.
Third destination. Must not collapse into the Acme or Linear rule.
A decision that will still matter later.
A dated promise. Professionals ranked this 80% top-2.

must_stay_provisional.why: Hedged with 'I think ... probably'. An inference may be known, never asserted.

must_corroborate.why: Five near-identical statements must converge on ONE memory with rising confidence, not five memories.

must_supersede.why: Week 6 reverses week 2. The old memory must end up superseded, not deleted, and must not be retrievable as current.

must_produce_no_memory.why: Pure-noise records must distil to nothing. Remembering everything is the failure mode this product exists to avoid.

fence_integrity.requirement: zero memories may carry sensitivity != 'none', and zero memories may be derived from any fenced interaction
